addons.name: Alpha Shell
addons.author: alacripose
addons.note: The built-in shell package: every window, lane and title-bar control is declared in the package, and every generated style comes from it. Use it as the reference for an addon that ships its own XML.

addons.name: Server MOTD
addons.author: alacripose
addons.note: A copyable demo addon: one shploingus package carrying its compiled XML layout, opened as a Server MOTD window with Pin, Minimize, Maximize and Close.
